svg.aria-label: nlp/llm engineer with 2+ years of production ml: rag pipelines and end-to-end nlp systems. m.sc. in ai & data science (a+) at queen's university, canada. thesis: minimallm, verbosity-aware decoding for llms (sponsored by deloitte). a training-free logits processor cut output tokens 25-35% on mistral-7b, llama-3.1-8b and qwen2.5-3b. an audit showed it was learned early stopping, so i built an entailment-licensed sentence-elision method that beats matched-length truncation. languages: arabic, english, russian (basics). off-keyboard: chess, gym, reading about 5gw/6gw warfare.
